articles.summary: On Monday, June 19th, Plug Power’s Spokane, WA office hosted a visit from Representative McMorris Rodgers during a technology tour she was taking in her home district. Sitting at the forefront of innovation, the Plug Power team was excited to highlight the paradigm-changing work done on a daily basis, in engineering, manufacturing and market creation. […]
